<style>
:root{--bg:#f6eddf;--paper:#fffaf2;--paper2:#fbf3e6;--ink:#2b1b12;--ink2:#5c4535;--muted:#8e7562;--line:rgba(43,27,18,.12);--line2:rgba(43,27,18,.22);--sun:#ff6a1a;--sun2:#ffb02e;--hot:#d8301b;--cool:#137f77;--body:#eadfce;--shadow:0 18px 50px -20px rgba(120,60,20,.35);--serif:"Noto Serif SC",serif;--mono:"DM Mono",ui-monospace,monospace}

*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html{overflow-x:hidden}
body{background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font-family:"Noto Sans SC",system-ui,sans-serif;min-height:100vh;overflow-x:hidden;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
button{font:inherit;color:inherit;background:none;border:0;cursor:pointer}
:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--sun);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:6px}
kbd{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.8em;padding:1px 7px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid var(--line2);border-bottom-width:2px;background:var(--paper)}
.mono{font-family:var(--mono)}.hidden{display:none!important}
.sunwash{position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:0;background:radial-gradient(circle at 85% -10%,rgba(255,176,46,.35),transparent 50%),radial-gradient(circle at 0% 110%,rgba(229,52,31,.12),transparent 50%)}
#app{position:relative;z-index:1;display:grid;grid-template-columns:150px minmax(0,1fr);min-height:100vh}
#rail{position:sticky;top:0;height:100vh;padding:26px 0 26px 26px;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.brand{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:900;font-size:30px;line-height:1}.brand small{display:block;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--muted);font-weight:400;margin-top:6px}
.therm{position:relative;flex:1;margin:22px 0 0 10px;width:110px}
.tube{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;bottom:46px;width:18px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--paper);border:2px solid var(--line2);overflow:hidden}
.merc{position:absolute;left:3px;right:3px;bottom:3px;border-radius:9px;background:linear-gradient(to top,var(--hot),var(--sun) 60%,var(--sun2));transition:height 1s cubic-bezier(.3,1.3,.5,1)}
.bulb{position:absolute;left:-13px;bottom:0;width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%,#ff8a4a,var(--hot));border:2px solid var(--line2);display:grid;place-items:center;color:#fff;font:500 11px var(--mono)}
.marks{position:absolute;left:26px;top:0;bottom:46px;width:110px}

#stage{flex:1;max-width:1200px;width:100%;margin:0 auto;padding:38px clamp(16px,4vw,56px) 28px;transition:opacity .45s,transform .55s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}
#stage.out{opacity:0;transform:translateX(-60px)}#stage.pre{opacity:0;transform:translateX(60px);transition:none}
.nav{position:sticky;bottom:0;z-index:20;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:12px clamp(16px,4vw,56px);background:linear-gradient(to top,var(--bg) 60%,transparent)}

.kick{font:500 12px var(--mono);letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--hot);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}.kick::before{content:"";width:28px;height:1px;background:currentColor}
h1{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:900;font-size:clamp(44px,7vw,92px);line-height:1.02}
h2{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:900;font-size:clamp(26px,3.4vw,42px);line-height:1.15;margin:10px 0}
.lead{color:var(--ink2);font-size:15px;line-height:1.8;max-width:700px}
.chead{margin-bottom:22px}

.card+.card{margin-top:14px}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:46px;padding:0 20px;border-radius:999px;border:1.5px solid var(--ink);font-weight:700;font-size:14px;transition:.2s;background:var(--paper)}
.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 6px 0 -2px var(--ink)}.btn:disabled{opacity:.3;pointer-events:none}
.btn-hot{background:var(--hot);border-color:var(--hot);color:#fff}

.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}

.lbl{display:block;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;margin-bottom:10px}
.hint{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
.photo{position:relative;aspect-ratio:16/10;border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden;background:#ccc;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.photo img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;user-select:none;-webkit-user-drag:none}

.toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0)}
.shake{animation:shake .45s}@keyframes shake{20%,60%{transform:translateX(-7px)}40%,80%{transform:translateX(7px)}}
.tabs{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:12px}.tab{padding:7px 13px;border-radius:999px;border:1.5px solid var(--line2);font:500 12px var(--mono)}.tab.on{border-color:var(--hot);color:var(--hot)}.tab.ok::after{content:" ✓";color:var(--cool)}

<script>
SPSite.onReady(function(ctx){

function swPlan(n){const all=[];[2,4,6,9,12].forEach(m=>[30,60,90].forEach(s=>[33,37,41].forEach(t=>all.push({m,s,t}))));for(let i=all.length-1;i>0;i--){const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));[all[i],all[j]]=[all[j],all[i]]}const out=[],seen={};for(const a of all){const k=a.m+'-'+a.s;if(seen[k])continue;seen[k]=1;out.push(a);if(out.length===n)break}return out}

  for(let it=0;it<3000;it++){const g=[0,0,0,0];X.forEach((x,i)=>{const p=1/(1+Math.exp(-x.reduce((s,v,k)=>s+v*w[k],0)));for(let k=0;k<4;k++)g[k]+=(p-y[i])*x[k]});for(let k=0;k<4;k++)w[k]-=.15*(g[k]/X.length+.05*w[k]*(k?1:0))}
  return{w,wtw:w[2]<-.05?Math.max(0,-(w[1]*.1)/(w[2]/10)):null}}

const OWNER={consent:0,comfort_temp:1,heat_sensitivity:1,climate:1,outdoor_walk:1,sun_habits:1,age_group:1,gender:1,feel_heat:2,heat_paint:3,shade_routes:4,shade_swipe:5,swipe_design:5,body_heat:6,cool_first:6,cooling_plan:7,cool_expected:7};
function submit(){const b=$('#submit');b.disabled=true;b.textContent='提交中…';SPSite.complete().then(r=>{if(r&&r.ok){$('#stage').innerHTML='<div style="text-align:center;margin-top:26vh"><h2>提交中…</h2><p class="lead" style="margin:auto">谢谢你，愿你的夏天多一些树荫。</p></div>';$('.nav').classList.add('hidden');return}
  b.disabled=false;b.textContent='提交答卷 ✦';const m=(r&&r.missing)||[];$('#miss').innerHTML=`<div class="missing">${esc((r&&r.error)||'提交失败')}<div class="chips" style="justify-content:center;margin-top:10px">${[...new Set(m.map(n=>OWNER[n]).filter(x=>x!=null))].map(i=>`<button class="chip" data-g="${i}">去完成「${CH[i].t}」</button>`).join('')}</div></div>`;$$('[data-g]').forEach(x=>x.onclick=()=>go(+x.dataset.g))})}

/* =============== 流程 =============== */
const CH=[
  {t:'序 · 正午',r:rIntro,v:()=>!sunDone?'先把太阳拖到正午':A.consent===true||'请勾选知情同意'},
  {t:'你',r:rYou,v:()=>A.heat_sensitivity==null?'请选择你有多怕热':!A.climate?'请选择气候区':!A.outdoor_walk?'请选择户外步行时长':A.comfort_temp==null?'请设置舒适温度':true},
  {t:'体感',r:rFeel,v:()=>tdone('feel_heat')||'还有街道未评估'},
  {t:'涂抹',r:rPaint,v:()=>tdone('heat_paint')||'每张街景都需要涂抹并保存'},
  {t:'寻荫',r:rRoute,v:()=>ROUNDS.every(r=>C.routes[r.id]&&C.routes[r.id].done)||'两个时段都需要画出路线'},
  {t:'取舍',r:rSwipe,v:()=>tdone('shade_swipe')||'还有卡片未选择'},
  {t:'身体',r:rBody,v:()=>Object.values(A.body_heat||{}).filter(v=>+v).length>=3||'请至少标注 3 个部位'},
  {t:'降温',r:rCool,v:()=>!!A.cooling_plan||'请至少放置一项改造'},
  {t:'档案',r:rReport,v:()=>true},
];
let ch=0,mx=0,busy=false;
function rail(){const n=CH.length-1,f=ch/n;$('#merc').style.height=`calc(${f*100}% - 6px)`;$('#merc').style.setProperty('--w',f*100+'%');$('#bulb').textContent=Math.round(24+f*18)+'°';
  $('#marks').innerHTML=CH.map((c,i)=>`<button class="mk ${i===ch?'cur':i<=mx?'done':''}" style="bottom:${i/n*100}%" data-i="${i}" ${i>mx?'disabled':''}>${c.t}</button>`).join('');$$('.mk').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>go(+b.dataset.i));
  $('#navMid').textContent=`${ch} / ${n}`;$('#prev').style.visibility=ch&&ch<n?'visible':'hidden';$('#next').style.visibility=ch<n?'visible':'hidden';$('#next').textContent=ch===n-1?'生成档案 ✦':'下一章 →'}
function go(i){if(busy||i<0||i>=CH.length)return;busy=true;dispose();const st=$('#stage');st.classList.add('out');
  setTimeout(()=>{ch=i;mx=Math.max(mx,i);st.classList.remove('out');st.classList.add('pre');st.innerHTML='';CH[i].r(st);scrollTo(0,0);rail();requestAnimationFrame(()=>requestAnimationFrame(()=>st.classList.remove('pre')));busy=false},400)}
function next(){const ok=CH[ch].v();if(ok!==true){toast(ok);const b=$('#next');b.classList.remove('shake');void b.offsetWidth;b.classList.add('shake');return}go(ch+1)}
$('#prev').onclick=()=>go(ch-1);$('#next').onclick=next;
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.target.matches&&e.target.matches('input,textarea'))return;if(keyH&&keyH(e))return;if(e.key==='Enter'&&!(e.target.matches&&e.target.matches('button,[role=button],[role=slider]'))){e.preventDefault();next()}});
CH[0].r($('#stage'));rail();
});
</script>
